name: mab-bernoulli
description: Classical MAB: 10 Bernoulli instances with 10 arms (means uniform in [0.05, 0.95], gap >= 0.05), 2 runs each. Theoretical defaults.

notices.title: Default hyperparameters
notices.text: alpha=1 for UCB1, UCB1Tuned, UCBV and UCBMinV1; c=3 for KLUCB. These are the values of the papers. They are safe in theory but often explore too much. To tune them, run a grid search: param_grid=True ("param_grid": true in a config file). Or set them yourself, e.g. UCB1(alpha=0.1).

notices.title: Not stored
notices.text: Per-action estimates ("estimates"), action of every step ("actions"), peak memory (measure_memory=True). The charts cannot show them. The brackets say how to store each one: a quoted name goes in track ("track": [...] in a config file).

notices.title: One point every 50 steps
notices.text: Curves keep one point every 50 steps, plus the last step. Between two points, the line is drawn, not measured. You set log_interval=50. log_interval=1 keeps every step (larger files).

notices.title: Parallel runs
notices.text: n_jobs=4: runs in parallel, one BLAS thread each. Compare CPU times only between runs with the same n_jobs.
